title: P.50 — tornar o título de Flanqueio editável
purpose: Replace the PT-BR SVG text overlay with the same localized wording in an ordinary editable PageRenderer text unit. Preserve the exact English source-PDF title overlay in EN.

sourceIssue.description: The PDF extractor emitted two offset text passes for one visibly clean source heading. Both were hidden behind image/vector title overlays; the PT-BR wording was not an ordinary editable text unit.

resolution.englishBehavior: Keep the exact source-PDF pixel overlay in EN and suppress the duplicate HTML pass in EN.
resolution.ptBRBehavior: Render the localized text from the normal translation record; remove the PT-BR SVG overlay from the active sidecar. The old SVG file is retained but no longer referenced.
resolution.duplicatePass: block_12 remains preserved in the DOM but is hidden from the page. block_16 is suppressed only in EN.

candidate.measurementMethod: The official PDF raster shows one visible heading even though the extracted text layer has two offset passes. The real PageRenderer export metrics measured the editable PT-BR title at 1 line in the 200% Viewer and 1 line in the 100% print pass; the source raster, Viewer, and print were inspected together. This is not claimed as a Copyfit V3 measurement.

pageLimit: This only fixes title editability. Page 50 remains uncertified because regular EN body text still appears heavier in the Viewer/print raster than in the official OG despite its stored 400 weight. The 15 body translation units and their existing review/legacy statuses were not changed.
titleTermDecision: BACKSTAB permanece em inglês porque nomeia a Tag impressa nos componentes; ‘Flanqueio e BACKSTAB’ é a forma PT-BR pretendida, não uma tradução incompleta. Nenhuma decisão global de glossário foi criada.
